title: Champion Charters

services.name: Charter Trip.
services.desc: Captain Jim started fishing on Lake Erie as a young man; primarily for walleye and perch. His love of fishing led to obtaining his USCG 50 ton Masters Captains License in 2015 and he is also a licensed Lake Erie Fishing Guide. After finding the perfect boat, he began Champion Charters and added a second boat in 2022. He believes in doing everything right every time and that attention to detail makes all the difference. He is passionate about not only catching fish; but having fun doing it. Champion Charters business was named after Captain Luke and his brother Captain Jake; both were outstanding high school and NCAA collegiate wrestlers obtaining state champion and NCAA champion titles.
